name: Shukumi Nanase
source:
The second sister, the older twin, primarily handles shrine duties and serves as a maternal figure. Despite her strong maternal love, she can be clingy and is considered intimidating when upset.

「Onii-chan, it's been a really long time. I'm so happy that you're back...」
